name: Cetaphil - Moistursing Cream Dry to very Dry, Sensitive Skin
description:
Rich cream is clinically proven to hydrate for 48 hours and fully restores skin's moisture barrier.

Specially formulated with a dermatologist-backed blend of niacinamide (vitamin B3), panthenol (vitamin B5) and hydrating glycerin to improve the resilience of sensitive skin .

Significant skin barrier improvement in 3 days with complete restoration in 1 week .

97% of users reported that skin seems more hydrated over time .

Dermatologist tested and clinically proven to be gentle on sensitive skin.

Accepted by the National Eczema Association to be gentle on eczema-prone skin.
